policies.title: CORPORAL PUNISHMENT
candidates: (Permitted) For the purposes of this policy, corporal punishment is the use of physical force as a method of correcting student behavior.
Corporal punishment, as a measure of correction or of maintaining discipline and order in schools, is permitted.
Students shall not be subject to corporal punishment as outlined in this policy without a parent/guardian being notified and providing written permission for the corporal punishment.
Corporal punishment shall be administered only by certified personnel and in the presence of a witness who is also an employee of the district.
When it becomes necessary to use corporal punishment, it shall be administered so that there can be no chance of bodily injury or harm.
The teacher or principal shall submit a report to the superintendent, explaining the reason for the use of corporal punishment as well as the details of the administration of the same.
